name: ecobee Smart Thermostat Enhanced (US)

radios.note: ecobee describes its smart thermostats as Wi-Fi-enabled. Retailers also list Bluetooth and a 915 MHz sensor radio; no maker page we saw confirms those.

matter.note: No ecobee page or CSA listing found for this model mentions Matter. Absence is not a statement that it lacks it.

apple_home.note: ecobee lists Apple HomeKit among supported platforms. HomeKit is a direct local pairing, separate from Matter.

google_home.note: ecobee lists Google Assistant among supported platforms.

alexa.note: ecobee lists Amazon Alexa among supported platforms.

smartthings.note: ecobee lists SmartThings among supported platforms.

home_assistant.note: Official ecobee integration (climate entity with Home, Away and Sleep comfort settings). HomeKit pairing is a separate local route.

hubRequired.note: Connects over Wi-Fi; no bridge needed.

localControl.note: No maker source states what works without internet. The Home Assistant ecobee integration uses ecobee's cloud.

systems.value: Most 24 V HVAC systems, incl. heat pumps
systems.note: ecobee says it supports most 24 V residential systems in North America; high-voltage and millivolt systems are not compatible.

power.value: C-wire 24 V; Power Extender Kit in box
power.note: 24 V on the C-wire. ecobee's Enhanced page says the included Power Extender Kit allows installation in most homes without a C-wire; its accessories page says every model except the Essential and Lite comes with the kit.

summary: Apple HomeKit, Alexa, Google Assistant and SmartThings are all listed by ecobee for the Smart Thermostat Enhanced, a US wall thermostat that connects over Wi-Fi. It handles most 24 V systems including heat pumps, and the included Power Extender Kit lets it go in most homes without a C-wire. Home Assistant supports it through the official ecobee integration.
caveats: Without a C-wire the Power Extender Kit needs a spare wire and is not compatible with dual-transformer, millivolt or high-voltage systems.
